column2: The island nation fiercely defended its sovereignty against any foreign claim to its territory.
column3: 這個島國堅決捍衛主權，抵抗任何外國對其領土的主張。
column5: 想像國王手握權杖，這塊地誰說了算，就是主權

column2: Historians argue that Athenian hegemony over the Aegean ended after the long war with Sparta.
column3: 歷史學家認為，雅典對愛琴海的霸權在與斯巴達的長期戰爭後終結。
column5: 想像一條黑鯨獨霸海洋，其他魚都得聽牠的

column2: The empire sought to subjugate neighboring tribes and force them to pay tribute.
column3: 帝國企圖征服鄰近的部落，並迫使他們進貢。
column4: subjugate a people (征服一個民族)
column5: sub 在下 + jug 牛軛：把人套上牛軛，壓在下面

column2: Lincoln's proclamation helped emancipate enslaved people across the Confederate states.
column3: 林肯的宣言幫助解放了南方邦聯各州的奴隸。
column5: e 出 + manci 手：從主人的手掌中放出來

column2: Only after the 1920 amendment were American women enfranchised and able to cast ballots.
column3: 直到1920年修正案通過，美國女性才獲得選舉權，得以投票。
column5: en 使 + franchise 公民權：發給選票，讓人有發言權
column8: 賦予公民權；賦予選舉權

column2: Strict ID laws, critics say, disenfranchise elderly voters who no longer hold valid documents.
column3: 批評者說，嚴格的證件法規剝奪了沒有有效證件的年長選民的投票權。
column5: dis 去掉 + enfranchise 給選票：把選票收回來

column2: Parliament voted to abrogate the 1890 treaty, ending obligations that had lasted a century.
column3: 國會投票廢止1890年的條約，結束了延續一世紀的義務。
column5: ab 離開 + rog 提請：把原本的法條請走，正式廢除
column8: 正式廢止；廢除法律協定

column2: After angry protests, the dean rescinded the new dress code before it ever took effect.
column3: 在憤怒的抗議之後，院長在新服裝規定生效前就將它撤銷了。
column5: re 回 + scind 切：把已下的命令切回去，收回來

column2: The state revoked his driver's license after a third violation within a single year.
column3: 在他一年內第三次違規後，州政府吊銷了他的駕照。
column5: re 回 + voke 叫：把給出去的許可叫回來

column2: Voters pressured lawmakers to repeal the unpopular tax passed only two years earlier.
column3: 選民向議員施壓，要求廢除兩年前才通過、不受歡迎的稅法。
column5: repeal 像 peel 剝皮：把法條像果皮一樣剝掉

column2: The journalist could not substantiate the rumor with a single document or credible witness.
column3: 這位記者拿不出任何文件或可信的證人來證實那個傳言。
column5: substance 實質 + ate：給說法補上實質證據，不再空口說

column2: Two independent witnesses corroborated her account of the accident, strengthening the case.
column3: 兩位獨立的目擊者佐證了她對事故的說法，讓案件更有力。
column5: cor 一起 + robor 強壯：大家一起讓這個說法變強壯

column2: The physicist refuted the rival theory with data that its supporters could not explain.
column3: 物理學家用支持者無法解釋的數據，駁倒了對手的理論。
column5: re 回敬：用證據把對方的話頂回去，證明它是錯的

column2: At the hearing, the lawyer calmly rebutted each charge with documents and witnesses.
column3: 聽證會上，律師用文件和證人冷靜地逐一反駁指控。
column5: re 回 + but 但是：一開口就說「But，不是這樣」

column2: Critics impugned the senator's motives, suggesting that donors, not principle, had shaped her vote.
column3: 批評者質疑參議員的動機，暗示左右她投票的是捐款人，而非原則。
column4: impugn someone's motives (質疑某人動機)
column5: im 向 + pugn 拳頭：對人的品格揮出質疑的拳

column2: She has long advocated free school meals for every child, regardless of family income.
column3: 她長期主張讓每個孩子都能吃到免費營養午餐，不論家庭收入如何。
column5: ad 向 + voc 聲音：為別人發聲、出聲支持的人

column2: The famous chef agreed to endorse the cookware brand after testing it in her own kitchen.
column3: 這位名廚在自家廚房試用後，同意為這個炊具品牌背書。
column5: en 在 + dors 背：在支票背面簽名，公開表示認可

column2: Human rights groups denounced the new law as a betrayal of the country's founding principles.
column3: 人權團體公開譴責這項新法，認為它背叛了國家的立國原則。
column5: de 向下 + nounce 宣告：當眾大聲宣布「這是錯的」

column2: The so-called healer proved a charlatan, selling worthless herbs with promises he could never keep.
column3: 這位所謂的治療師原來是江湖騙子，賣無用的草藥，許下無法兌現的承諾。
column5: 諧音「沙拉攤」：沙拉攤老闆吹牛說一碗能治百病

column2: A noted sybarite, the count spent his fortune on silk robes, rich banquets, and perfumed baths.
column3: 那位伯爵是出名的享樂者，把財產花在絲袍、豪華宴會和香水浴上。
column4: a wealthy sybarite (富有的享樂者)
column5: 古城 Sybaris 的居民愛奢華，天天躺著吃甜點

column2: The zealot refused every compromise, convinced that anyone who disagreed was an enemy of the cause.
column3: 這名狂熱分子拒絕一切妥協，深信不同意的人都是理念的敵人。
column5: zeal 熱忱 + ot 人：熱情過頭、一根筋的人
column8: 狂熱分子；盲目狂熱之徒

column2: Once a loyal party member, he became an apostate and publicly condemned its leaders.
column3: 他曾是忠誠的黨員，後來成了背棄者，公開批評黨的領導人。
column4: an apostate from the faith (背教者)
column5: apo 離開 + state 站：站到原本陣營的外面去

column2: The renegade general abandoned his army's cause and sold its battle plans to the enemy.
column3: 那位叛將背棄了軍隊的理想，把作戰計畫賣給敵人。
column5: re 回頭 + neg 否認：否認原本的信念，轉身離去

column2: After the scandal, the once-popular mayor became a pariah whom former friends crossed the street to avoid.
column3: 醜聞之後，曾廣受歡迎的市長成了被排斥的人，昔日朋友見到他都繞道走。
column4: a social pariah (被社會排斥的人)
column5: 諧音「怕里啊」：大家都怕靠近他，把他排在外面

column2: The young pianist became the cynosure of the entire hall the moment she began to play.
column3: 年輕的鋼琴家一開始演奏，就成為全場矚目的焦點。
column4: the cynosure of attention (注目焦點)
column5: 原指北極星，是旅人抬頭就看的中心；諧音「西諾秀」
column8: 引人注目的焦點；指引中心

column2: The parade displayed a splendid panoply of flags, costumes, floats, and marching bands.
column3: 遊行展出旗幟、服裝、花車與樂隊，陣容壯觀。
column4: a panoply of colors (種種繽紛色彩)
column5: pan 全部 + oply 武裝：一整套全副裝備，全部亮出來
column8: 全套防護裝備；全套陳列；大展

column2: The newspaper's panegyric to the retiring coach praised his patience, wisdom, and thirty years of service.
column3: 報紙寫給退休教練的頌文，稱讚他的耐心、智慧與三十年的付出。
column5: pan 全 + egyr 集會：在全體大會上朗讀的讚美詞

column2: The senator's farewell speech was an encomium so warm that the retiring judge blushed.
column3: 參議員的告別演說是如此熱情的讚揚，讓退休的法官都臉紅了。
column5: 和 eulogy 一樣是讚美，但對象多半還在世、不是追悼

column2: Mid-meeting, the manager launched into a tirade about missed deadlines that left everyone silent.
column3: 會議進行到一半，經理突然長篇怒罵延誤的期限，讓大家鴉雀無聲。
column4: launch into a tirade (開始長篇怒罵)
column5: 諧音「踢人的」：嘴巴像一直在踢人，罵個不停

column2: Her diatribe against the new parking rules lasted twenty minutes and ignored every counterargument.
column3: 她痛批新停車規定的長篇抨擊持續了二十分鐘，對所有反駁都置之不理。
column5: dia 貫穿 + tribe 摩擦：一路磨擦、不斷攻擊的言論

column2: The coach harangued his team for an hour, pacing the locker room and pounding the wall.
column3: 教練對球隊慷慨激昂地訓話了一小時，在休息室來回踱步並捶著牆。
column4: harangue the crowd (對群眾長篇演說)
column5: 諧音「哈忍歌」：台上滔滔不絕，台下只好忍著哈欠聽
column8: 慷慨激昂地訓話；高談闊論

column2: In a fiery philippic, the senator accused the administration of lying to the public for years.
column3: 參議員以一篇火力十足的痛斥演說，指控政府多年來欺瞞大眾。
column4: deliver a philippic (發表痛斥演說)
column5: 源自古希臘演說家痛批腓力王的演說，對著他開砲

column2: He posted a rambling screed against the city council, five thousand words long and full of grudges.
column3: 他貼出一篇針對市議會的冗長文章，長達五千字，滿是怨氣。
column5: 諧音「斯克累」：讀完會累的長篇抱怨文

column2: The editorial was a jeremiad lamenting the decline of civic life and blaming nearly everyone for it.
column3: 這篇社論是一篇哀嘆公民生活沒落的悲嘆文，幾乎把每個人都怪了一遍。
column5: 源自聖經先知 Jeremiah，整天嘆氣說世道變壞

column2: The poet wrote an elegy for her grandmother, recalling the garden where they had spent summers.
column3: 詩人為祖母寫了一首輓歌，回憶她們一起度過夏天的花園。
column5: 諧音「哀了結」：哀傷地替離去的人寫下的詩

column2: Bagpipes played a slow dirge as the procession moved through the silent village.
column3: 隊伍穿過寂靜的村莊時，風笛吹奏著緩慢的哀樂。
column5: 緩慢低沉、像拖著腳步前進的送別曲

column2: Crowds sang a joyful paean to the returning champions, filling the stadium with song.
column3: 群眾向凱旋歸來的冠軍高唱歡欣的讚歌，歌聲響滿整座體育場。
column5: p 開頭的 praise 讚美：paean 就是讚美的歌

column2: The choir sang an old hymn, and the congregation joined in softly.
column3: 唱詩班唱起一首古老的聖歌，會眾也輕聲跟著唱。
column5: 發音像 him：他在教堂裡唱聖歌，結尾的 n 不發音

column2: Her pithy reply, just four words long, settled the argument better than a speech could.
column3: 她只有四個字的精闢回答，比長篇大論更能平息爭論。
column5: pith 是橘子皮內的白芯、核心：只留精華的話

column2: The trenchancy of her critique exposed flaws that months of polite review had missed.
column3: 她評論的犀利深刻，揭露了數月客氣審查所遺漏的缺陷。
column5: trench 溝渠：像挖溝一樣切得又深又利
